              DETECTION OF BUZZER USING LDR

* Problem Statement  
    
  To detect changes in light intensity using an LDR and activate a buzzer as an alert.  
    
* Components

- [ ] LDR  
        
- [ ] Buzzer  
        
- [ ] LED  
        
- [ ] Resistor  
        
- [ ] Transistor  
        
- [ ] 9V Battery  
        
- [ ] Breadboard & Connecting Wires  
    


*  Working

The LDR senses the light intensity. When the light condition changes, its resistance changes and the circuit activates the buzzer and LED.

* Applications

- Security alarm  
-   
- Door/window detection  
-   
- Light-sensitive alarm  
-   
- Automatic lighting systems

* Result

The circuit successfully detects light changes using LDR and produces an alert through the buzzer.
